description: This file defines the ConditionalFormatting class for reading and interpreting conditional formatting rules in XLS files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides mappings and methods to retrieve the type and operator strings based on integer codes, aiding in parsing conditional formatting data.

classes.name: ConditionalFormatting
classes.description: A class providing static methods and properties to handle conditional formatting types and operators during XLS file reading.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the conditional formatting type based on the provided integer code.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the conditional formatting operator based on the provided integer code.
